Name: Veltrysinib Alpha
Clinical_Indication: Chemotherapy-sparing prophylaxis of Embryonal Rhabdomyosarcoma and Wilms tumor in MVA.
Hypothesis: Selectively triggers premature, catastrophic mitotic entry in aneuploid cells with biallelic BUB1B mutation.

Name: Mitotectin Beta
Clinical_Indication: Eradication of aneuploid cell lineages exhibiting chromosomal instability.
Hypothesis: Abrogates PKMYT1-dependent G2/M arrest, forcing lethal mitosis in tetraploid/aneuploid clones.

Name: Macrocycle-W1
Clinical_Indication: Long-term oral maintenance therapy with bone marrow sparing.
Hypothesis: High kinome selectivity over PLK1 and Aurora A, precluding hematological toxicity in pediatric patients.

Name: Kinosartan MVA
Clinical_Indication: Neuro-oncological chemoprevention in mosaic variegated aneuploidy.
Hypothesis: Excellent central nervous system penetration to prevent medulloblastoma or aneuploid embryonal blastomas.

Name: Thienopyridyl-05
Clinical_Indication: Acute cytoreduction of rapidly proliferating embryonal malignancies.
Hypothesis: Blocks phosphorylation of CDK1 at Tyr15, eliminating checkpoint control in aneuploid tumor cells.

Name: Senol-PROTAC CRBN
Clinical_Indication: Targeted senolysis of growth-arrested cells; reversal of severe failure to thrive.
Hypothesis: Platelets lack CRBN machinery; thus MVA-PRO-01 degrades BCL-xL in senescent somatic cells with zero thrombocytopenia.

Name: Senol-PROTAC VHL
Clinical_Indication: Clearance of senescent renal tubular epithelial cells; antifibrotic nephroprotection.
Hypothesis: Recruits VHL E3 ligase for rapid ubiquitin-proteasome degradation of pro-survival BCL-xL.

Name: Biclon-PEG PROTAC
Target: Dual BCL-xL / BCL-2 E3 Ligase Degradation
Clinical_Indication: Pan-senolytic clearance in fibrotic and hypertrophic musculoskeletal tissues.
Hypothesis: Extended PEG linker optimizes spatial distance between E3 ligase and target, accelerating degradation kinetics.

Name: MCL1-Shedder
Target: MCL-1 BH3 Groove / CRBN E3 Ligase
Clinical_Indication: Overcoming anti-apoptotic resistance in residual aneuploid embryonal blasts.
Hypothesis: Degrades compensatory MCL-1 upregulation, preventing senolytic escape in refractory malignant cells.

Name: Navitobioisostere
Clinical_Indication: Direct oral small-molecule senolytic therapy for low-resource settings.
Hypothesis: Selective bioisosteric modification preserves BCL-xL affinity while reducing platelet clearance toxicity.

Name: Kinetochorin Alpha
Clinical_Indication: Restoration of mitotic chromosome alignment and tension sensing in MVA.
Hypothesis: Binds the neck-linker of CENPE kinesin-7, allosterically rescuing motor processivity against p.Arg1079Gln.

Name: Quinazo-Motor
Clinical_Indication: Enhancement of plus-end-directed chromosome motility at the metaphase plate.
Hypothesis: Couples ATP hydrolysis to conformational neck-linker stepping, preventing lagging chromosomes.

Name: Benzimidaz-CEN
Clinical_Indication: Strengthening of microtubule end-on capture at hypomorphic kinetochores.
Hypothesis: Stabilizes ionic and hydrophobic contacts between CENPE motor domain and beta-tubulin helix H11.

Name: Tetrahydro-Step
Clinical_Indication: Prevention of stalk unraveling and premature dissociation during chromosome congress.
Hypothesis: Acts as an allosteric molecular staple across the stalk dimerization interface to preserve mechanical stiffness.

Name: Indol-BubR1 Tether
Clinical_Indication: Re-anchoring CENPE to mutant BUB1B kinetochore platforms.
Hypothesis: Chemically bridges the weakened interface between BubR1 basic motif and the CENPE C-terminal tail.

Name: Micronucleocin A
Clinical_Indication: Suppression of sterile neuroinflammation triggered by micronuclei rupture.
Hypothesis: Competitively blocks ATP/GTP condensation into 2'3'-cGAMP within the catalytic cleft of cGAS.

Name: Sting-Block C91
Clinical_Indication: Prevention of microglial activation, progressive microcephaly, and neurocognitive decline.
Hypothesis: Forms a covalent adduct with Cys91, preventing STING palmitoylation and subsequent oligomeric activation.

Name: Fas-OligoShield
Clinical_Indication: Interruption of cytosolic chromatin condensation into inflammatory foci.
Hypothesis: Disrupts multivalency between basic cGAS patches and micronuclear dsDNA fragments.

Name: Cerebro-Sting-04
Clinical_Indication: High-penetrance central nervous system neuroprotection in pediatric encephalopathy.
Hypothesis: Optimized logP and low polar surface area facilitate rapid blood-brain barrier penetration to silence microglial STING.

Name: Dual-TBK1 Kinase-Inh
Class: Downstream Type I Interferon Signaling Inhibitor
Clinical_Indication: Terminal suppression of IRF3 phosphorylation and IFN-beta storm.
Hypothesis: Selectively inhibits TBK1 kinase activity downstream of STING, halting IFN-driven multi-organ damage.
